readme:
# Trustpilot Reviews Scraper

Scrape reviews and business profiles from [Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/). Extract ratings, review text, author names, dates, and company data.

## What You Get

The output contains two types of items:

**Business profiles** (`type: "business"`):
- Company name, domain, website
- Trust score and average rating
- Total review count
- Categories, country, logo

**Individual reviews** (`type: "review"`):
- Star rating (1-5), title, full review text
- Author name, country, total reviews by author
- Date posted and date of experience
- Verified purchase status
- Company reply text and date (if any)
- Review source (Organic, Invited, etc.)

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/trustpilot-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `trustpilot-scraper` to scrape company data from trustpilot. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## How To Use

### Option 1: Paste business URLs

```json
{
  "urls": ["https://www.trustpilot.com/review/amazon.com"],
  "maxReviewsPerBusiness": 50
}
```

### Option 2: Search for businesses

Find companies by keyword — the scraper discovers matching businesses and extracts their reviews:

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "software company germany",
  "maxResults": 10,
  "maxReviewsPerBusiness": 20
}
```

### Option 3: Business profiles only (no reviews)

Set `maxReviewsPerBusiness` to 0 to get only business summary data:

```json
{
  "searchQuery": "insurance",
  "maxResults": 50,
  "maxReviewsPerBusiness": 0
}
```

## Filters

- **Sort reviews** by `recency` (newest first) or `relevance`
- **Filter by stars** — only scrape 1-star, 5-star, or any specific rating

## Pricing

Pay-per-result pricing. You only pay for the data you receive.

| Event | Price | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| Business scraped | $0.003 | A business profile with trust score, rating, and categories |
| Review scraped | $0.001 | An individual review with text, author, and rating |

**Examples:**
- 1 business + 100 reviews = **$0.103**
- 10 businesses + 20 reviews each = **$0.230**
- 50 business profiles only = **$0.150**

No monthly fees. No minimum spend.

## Proxy

Residential proxy is recommended for best results. Datacenter proxy may work but can be rate-limited.
